/** No return type. */
export function implicitFunction(value: number) {
  return value * 2;
}

/** No return type on the arrow. */
export const implicitArrow = (value: number) => value * 2;

/** No return type on the function expression. */
export const implicitExpression = function (value: number) {
  return value;
};

/** Typed through the variable annotation, which is fine. */
export const typedThroughVariable: (value: number) => number = (value) => value;

/** Typed on the arrow, which is fine. */
export const explicitArrow = (value: number): number => value;

/** A class with mixed methods. */
export class Mixed {
  /** No return type. */
  implicitMethod(value: number) {
    return value;
  }

  /** Has a return type. */
  explicitMethod(value: number): number {
    return value;
  }

  /** Private methods are not checked. */
  private implicitPrivate() {
    return 1;
  }

  /** Static methods are. */
  static implicitStatic() {
    return 2;
  }
}

/** Not a function; no return type applies. */
export const plainValue = 42;

const localArrow = (value: number) => value;

export { localArrow };
